sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-Kazakh API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Methodology This model is produced in two stages on top of our Kazakh continued-pretraining model issai/Qwen3.5-9B-Base-Kazakh, the official Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base continued-pretrained on Kazakh text with a +16K Kazakh-token vocabulary extension. No additional post-training (SFT, RLHF, or RLVR) is used.
